in_sanskrit.name: नीला
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The color blue, dark-blue or indigo. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nilam' which means 'blue lotus'. Nila is a popular name for girls in Hindu communities.

in_hindi.name: नीला
in_hindi.long_meaning: नीला (nīlā) is the Hindi translation of the Sanskrit word 'नीला' (nīlā). It means 'blue, dark-blue, or indigo'.

in_tamil.name: நிலா
in_tamil.long_meaning: The Tamil translation of 'नीला' (nīlā) is 'நிலா' (nilā). It is derived from the Tamil word 'நிலம்' (nilam) which means 'blue lotus'. Nila is a popular name for girls in Tamil communities.

in_telugu.name: నిల
in_telugu.long_meaning: The Telugu translation of 'नीला' (nīlā) is 'నిల' (nil). It is derived from the Telugu word 'నీల' (nīl) which means 'blue'. Nila is a popular name for girls in Telugu communities.

vedic_reference.note: Nila is a popular name for girls in Hindu communities, and has its roots in the Sanskrit word 'नीला' (nīlā) which means 'blue'. It is derived from the word 'nilam' which means 'blue lotus'. In Hindu mythology, the god Krishna is often depicted as having a blue complexion, symbolizing his divine nature and his connection to the element water.
